about.bio: I'm a Computer Systems Engineer with 6+ years of experience building and deploying web and mobile applications for banking, fintech, and automotive clients. Specialized in React and Node.js, with a solid foundation in Java/Spring Boot backend development. Experienced in Linux environments, Docker containers, Kubernetes, Git/GitHub, and cloud platforms such as AWS. Knowledgeable in infrastructure as code using Terraform and CloudFormation, AWS service management, and DevOps practices focused on automation and continuous delivery. Proven ability to collaborate across development and infrastructure teams to ensure scalable, secure, and highly available applications.
